articles.title: How to Build a Low-Cost Earthquake Monitor with Raspberry Shake
articles.author: Vijayaramanan
articles.excerpt: Set up a Raspberry Shake as a personal earthquake monitor, stream live seismic waveforms, establish a quiet baseline, and interpret events responsibly.

articles.title: What Makes a Rocket Reusable? The Engineering of Controlled Recovery
articles.author: Vijayaramanan
articles.excerpt: A reusable rocket is not simply an expendable rocket with landing legs. It is a launch system designed to reserve propellant, survive ascent and atmospheric entry, guide itself through a narrow landing corridor, and return its most valuable hardware to flight condition.

articles.title: How to Extract the Quality Factor of a Superconducting Resonator from S21 Data
articles.author: Vijayaramanan
articles.excerpt: Learn how to extract resonance frequency and internal quality factor from complex S21 data using bandwidth checks, circle fitting, residual analysis, and reproducible reporting.

articles.title: Why Earthquakes Happen: Fault Stress, Friction, and Seismic Rupture
articles.author: Vijayaramanan
articles.excerpt: Earthquakes occur when accumulated tectonic stress overcomes friction on a fault and a rupture propagates through the crust. This guide explains the mechanics from plate motion and elastic rebound to seismic waves, magnitude, and hazard engineering.

articles.title: How Earth Generates Its Magnetic Field: The Physics of the Geodynamo
articles.author: Vijayaramanan
articles.excerpt: Earth's magnetic field is a self-sustaining magnetohydrodynamic dynamo powered by convection, rotation, and the cooling and chemical evolution of the liquid outer core.

articles.title: How to Create a GitHub Repository and Add Code
articles.author: Vijayaramanan
articles.excerpt: Learn how to create a GitHub repository, connect it to a local project, commit your files, and push code safely from the command line.

articles.title: Passive Radiative Cooling: The Physics of Cooling Without Power
articles.author: Vijayaramanan
articles.excerpt: How engineered surfaces reflect sunlight, emit infrared radiation through the atmospheric window, and reject heat to space without a compressor, refrigerant, or electrical input.

articles.title: Neuromorphic Computing Explained: How Brain-Inspired Hardware Computes with Spikes
articles.author: Vijayaramanan
articles.excerpt: Neuromorphic computers replace clocked, data-hungry processing with sparse spikes, local memory, and event-driven dynamics. This guide explains the models, chips, trade-offs, and engineering opportunities behind the architecture.

articles.title: Autonomous AI Agents: The System Architecture Beyond the LLM
articles.author: Vijayaramanan
articles.excerpt: An autonomous AI agent is not a larger prompt wrapped around an LLM. It is a closed-loop system combining state, planning, memory, tools, permissions, evaluation, and human oversight. This guide explains how those layers fit together—and where production systems fail.

articles.title: The Post-Titanium Era: How Super Steel Could Scale Green Hydrogen Production
articles.author: Vijayaramanan
articles.excerpt: A new generation of corrosion-resistant “super steel” could replace selected titanium components in PEM electrolyzers, cutting material costs while surviving high-voltage, chloride-rich conditions.

articles.title: Metric Engineering & Dynamic Spacetime Geometries: Beyond Alcubierre
articles.author: Vijayaramanan
articles.excerpt: Analyzing physical energy condition modifications, Lentz positive-energy soliton solutions, and pulsed electromagnetic field generation for sub-light and superluminal metric bubbles.

articles.title: Fundamentals of Gravitational Field Modification & Metric Engineering
articles.author: Vijayaramanan
articles.excerpt: A comprehensive investigation into the theoretical paradigms, electromagnetic field coupling, and metric distortion equations governing non-Newtonian propulsion and gravitational shielding.
